q1: SELECT name FROM drinker WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT f.bar FROM frequents AS f, serves AS s WHERE f.drinker = drinker.name AND f.bar = s.bar AND NOT s.beer IN (SELECT beer FROM likes WHERE drinker = drinker.name))
q2: SELECT f.drinker FROM frequents AS f JOIN serves AS s ON f.bar = s.bar RIGHT JOIN likes AS l ON f.drinker = l.drinker AND s.beer = l.beer GROUP BY f.drinker HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN l.beer IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) = 0
